All — thanks for the fast turnaround. Attached is a concise proposed mapping (PDF) that:
- Canonicalizes Contoso CRM IDs to a single account per relationship
- Assigns primary AE owners for each account (and a secondary owner where regional overlap exists)
- Flags six contested accounts for controlled canary handoff (we’ll leave them in "pending" until AE confirmation)

Proposed next steps and timeline:
1) Redwood confirms contested owners by Tue 23 Nov (Vanessa / Karthik / Neha to finalize)
2) I’ll push the mapping to Microsoft Partner Center intake on Wed 24 Nov and request an expedited re-ingestion
3) Microsoft validates and enables co-sell routing; we’ll monitor referral delivery for 48 hours and confirm closure

A couple of operational guardrails for the mapping:
- For multi-region accounts, we recommend primary ownership follow the billing/legal entity that Contoso designates; if Contoso cannot advise, default to the AE with highest active seat consumption in HubSpot.
- For accounts with split ownership, mark a single primary owner in Partner Center and record shared owners in our CRM notes to preserve collaboration credit.

Attachments: pc_mapping_proposal_20271121.pdf

Alicia — if Contoso has a preference on primary ownership for any of the canonicalized accounts, please let us know by EOD Monday (22 Nov). If you prefer we route ownership questions through your procurement contact, share that contact and we’ll engage them instead.
